GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: A top 1% food platform for college students. Focus on emotion, energy, and eco-consciousness. Avoid the generic 'red/orange whole-site' fast-food look. Use an 'Oat Milk' warm base to feel premium, accented by an energetic Radish Pink and a crisp Matcha Green. Every page must feel emotionally directed. Prioritize contrast, generous spacing (2-3x standard), and high-density functional bento grids.

theme_strategy.description: Nature/Food relates closely to light themes. We will use a toggle, but optimize for an Oat-Milk base (warm food-inspired neutral) in light mode.

rules: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for headings.
Tight letter spacing on all headings.
No generic 'Bold'—use 'Black' for hero, 'Medium' for body.
Use energetic primary (Radish Pink/Fuchsia) for main CTAs and Mood tags.
Use eco-green for Daily Tiffin and Eco Impact indicators.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers must have internal padding.
grids_and_layouts.app_pages: High Density Grid (Mode B) for dashboard/orders.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense content.
grids_and_layouts.hero_overlay: Max overlay bg-black/40. If gradient needed, use bg-gradient-to-r from-black/70 to-transparent.

surfaces_and_components.cards: Flat solid surfaces with subtle nested radii. No generic floaty shadows. Use 1px border border-border with subtle colored shadow on hover.
surfaces_and_components.navbar: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, 1px bottom border.
surfaces_and_components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Hover: slight scale up and color shift.
surfaces_and_components.tags: High contrast pills. Background matches category (e.g. green for eco).
surfaces_and_components.modals_toasts: Use Sonner for toasts. Shadcn Dialog for modals. Ensure rounded-2xl.
rules: DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns/menus.
Use Shadcn UI components for logic, but customize styles heavily.
Avoid generic HTML input/select. Use Shadcn variants.
Hover states on ALL interactive elements.
Spring physics for mood card interactions.

icons.rules: Default choice. Clean, stroke-based. Size appropriately.

media_and_images.rules: No placeholder text/URLs. Use provided URLs for all imagery.

hero_group_orders.description: Friends sharing pizza indoors. Use for Group Orders feature or main Hero.

tiffin_eco.description: Healthy meal prep boxes. Use for Daily Tiffin section.

mood_studying.description: Two young adults studying with coffee. Use for 'Studying' Mood Card.

mood_rainy.description: Concentrated student with hot drink. Use for 'Rainy Day' / 'Comfort' Mood Card.

food_generic.description: Slice of pizza. Use for single order / general food display.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA standards or WCAG AA minimum. Explicit hover text colors.
accessibility.testing: All interactive/key elements MUST have data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind config with new variables (colors, fonts).
2. Setup CSS variables in index.css matching the 'colors' section.
4. Build Home Page: Hero with 'What does today feel like?', AI input box, Bento Grid for Mood Cards.
5. Build 'Explore' & 'Tiffin' sections with Grid density mode B.
8. Integrate Framer Motion for list staggering and hover states.
9. Add Sonner Toasts for interactions (e.g. 'Added to group cart').
10. Ensure fully responsive, mobile-first design (bottom nav on mobile).
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Don't make generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Use layered z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Use modern pill-shaped or sharp buttons with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters.
Apply 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Use .js/.jsx extensions for all React component files, NOT .tsx.
